            else

      break;

      */
      tag=(*(property+5) == '@') ? 1UL : 0UL;

      */
      n/=4;

        for (i=(ssize_t) n-1L; i >= 0; i--)
        {
          c=(*property++);
          tag<<=4;
          if ((c >= '0') && (c <= '9'))
            tag|=(c-'0');
          else
            if ((c >= 'A') && (c <= 'F'))
              tag|=(c-('A'-10));
            else
              if ((c >= 'a') && (c <= 'f'))

      */

          break;
